name: sre

findings.message: _ENGINE_OWNED_NS_RE is a new hardcoded enumeration of engine-owned namespace prefixes introduced by this change; it currently matches event-schema.json exactly (verified), but is not derived from that file, so a future engine namespace added to event-schema.json without updating this constant would leave the SPEC-2 guard blind to a plugin claiming it.

reason: the sre lens found no high or critical problem the change introduced that fails it
